entries.text: `translate_sql_query` translates every statement of a multi-statement input and joins them with `;` and a newline, applying the requested rewrites to each statement. It used to translate only the first statement and silently drop the rest. The only shipped input affected is the bulk `get_queries()` text of TPC-DS queries 14, 23, 24 and 39 (dsqgen emits two parts); the run path executes those as the separate `14a`/`14b`, `23a`/`23b`, `24a`/`24b` and `39a`/`39b` queries, so published results do not change.
